messages:
maya.cs: FYI customer Gamma Health reports a sudden drop in rerank quality after the embedding rollout last night. ~30% drop in top-3 relevance on their eval set. Ticket CS-1428 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-1428

tom.pm: thanks maya. is the failure in the embedding similarity scores or the reranker model downstream? any quick logs?

liam.ml: quick triage: looks like cosine sims on their test queries shifted down — avg went from ~0.78 -> ~0.62 on their sample after open-embed-v2 went live for them. grabbed a small query set and ran a quick check:
```sql
-- sample check
SELECT avg(sim) as avg_sim FROM rerank_logs WHERE customer = 'gamma' AND ts >= '2024-04-24';
-- result: avg_sim = 0.62
```
not seeing obvious reranker errors, so likely embedding distribution change.

sarah.prod: how urgent is Gamma on this? are they blocked in prod?

maya.cs: they're seeing unrelated policy docs in top results — customer says it's impacting workflows and revenue (search-based billing). They are explicitly asking for rollback to previous embedding bundle unless we can patch fast.

tom.pm: @liam can a rollback to open-embed-v1 be done per-customer? what's the blast radius and time estimate?

liam.ml: yes, we have per-tenant model routing. rollback path exists. rough estimate: 1-2h to flip routing + smoke tests and run their eval. Need QA run on control bucket to avoid regressions. Risk is small but we should canary first.

jayden.se: suggestion: canary rollback limited to Gamma, run their eval harness + 2 other control tenants. @sarah we should treat as high severity but small-scope remediation rather than engineering deep-dive until we have more data. :+1:

sarah.prod: agreed. proposed launch criteria for rollback: 1) Gamma's rerank precision(top-3) >= 0.75 on their eval after rollback, 2) no >2% degradation on control tenants, 3) 30m smoke window with monitoring. If all good, keep rollback and open follow-up to investigate embedding drift.

maya.cs: customer prefers rollback vs tuning. they want proactive comms and an ETA.

tom.pm: decision: schedule rollback today in Gamma's region. @incidents-bot please open an incident for tracking and page oncall. I’ll own backlog update & prioritization.

incidents-bot: created incident INC-20240425-17 for ticket CS-1428. oncall paged. https://redwood.incidents/INC-20240425-17

tom.pm: owners: liam.ml = rollback lead, jayden.se = QA + metrics, maya.cs = customer comms, sarah.prod = product approver. I'll mark this P0 and add a short spec to the roadmap backlog: "gamma rollback + postmortem".

jayden.se: I'll run A/B comparison and provide a one-pager with precision/recall and sample hits. ETA ~3h.

liam.ml: starting rollback prep now. I'll post a short playbook in thread with steps and smoke commands (will include the exact routing toggle + verification queries).

maya.cs: thanks all — I'll tell Gamma we aim to have a canary rollback and results within ~4h and will share the ticket updates. :pray:

sarah.prod: after rollback we need a scoped product ticket: "embedding distribution regression analysis + gated rollout rules". keep as follow-up to decide long-term (model vetting, automated regression evals).

tom.pm: noted. rolling this into today's roadmap sync as an emergency P0. follow-up ticket to product backlog for deeper investigation.

liam.ml: playbook draft (will paste soon) — posting once ready.

maya.cs: ping @Gamma contact saying we have a rollback plan and will confirm when canary finishes.

end of thread.
